# Vertical cut back on a 16:9 canvas with a blurred backdrop

The 9:16 vertical from f01 placed on a 1920x1080 canvas for YouTube, a website or a presentation screen: the clip sits sharp in the centre, and a blurred, scaled copy of itself fills the sides instead of black bars.

- Type: Blurred-background landscape
- Skill: `magnifito-variants`
- Engine: `blur-bg`
- Output: 1920x1080, 8 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/f03-blur-bg.mp4`](../videos/f03-blur-bg.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> I only have the vertical cut ../videos/f01-reframe-vertical.mp4 and need a 16:9 version for YouTube and our website. Do not stretch or crop it: put the vertical clip in the middle of a 1920x1080 canvas and fill the sides with a blurred copy of the same video, no black bars. Keep the audio.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f03-blur-bg
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f03-blur-bg/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo blur-bg ../videos/f01-reframe-vertical.mp4 --out work/landscape.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/landscape.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
